# Marketplace plugin catalog

One row per marketplace plugin: `name — [keywords] — description`. Regenerated by scripts/generate.sh; consumed by the plugin-scout skill of stack-scan.

all-plugins — [tooling, generic] — Installs every leaf plugin of this marketplace at one scope (local by default) with zero prompts, raises skillListingBudgetFraction in that scope's settings so the whole skill listing is sent instead of overflowing the default budget (~6x at 200k), and undoes both — one script with an exit code (0 done, 1 a plugin failed, 2 the marketplace is not added), via /all-plugins:install and /all-plugins:uninstall or straight from the marketplace clone. Whether the overflow changes what fires measured once at zero delta (rationale/2026-09-15-listing-eviction-probe.md); the step makes it moot for one visible key. Never installs a bundle, never prompts, never picks — that is /stack-scan:suggest.
api-design — [api, backend, review, docs] — APIs in both directions: design your own (resource naming, status-code discipline, pagination/filtering/sorting, versioning, RFC 9457 errors, idempotency, Laravel API Resources, plus a graphql-grpc skill for non-REST surfaces; /api-design:review and spec-first /api-design:scaffold) and consume others' honestly — verify current official API/SDK docs before writing integration code (UserPromptSubmit reminder + /api-design:check, the api-docs-first skill) and keep your own docs true after a change with the docs-upkeep drift scan: README claims, changelog gaps, stale examples, dead links (/api-design:drift).
approaches — [process, planning] — Solution-approach deliberation before non-trivial implementation: 2-3 structurally different approaches with trade-offs and a kill-trigger, a strategy catalog mapped to the risk each beats, a four-persona blind opinion round for refactor-shaped tasks — plus the merged pre-code disciplines: build-vs-buy checks, rollout planning, design-pattern selection, and /approaches:consult, a blind stronger-model second opinion when a session is stuck or about to do something irreversible (fresh-take merged in). Includes /approaches:compare, /approaches:opinions, /approaches:build-vs-buy, /approaches:rollout, /approaches:pattern.
ask-ledger — [generic, quality, hooks] — Catches the silent avert — work that quietly does less than the ask named, with no reason written anywhere. On the first work-shaped prompt a hook destructures the ask into its named things (proper nouns, quoted terms, 2D/3D-style tokens) and keeps them as a session ledger; a Stop gate refuses a final message that does not account for each one — `<name>: as named | substituted → what, why | omitted → why`. The script proves the accounting exists; whether it is true is the model's word and the reader's eye. Off with CC_ASK_LEDGER=off.
brain — [tooling, hooks] — A committed, Obsidian-style codebase map for a project: brain/INDEX.md indexes areas, key files, and notable classes/entrypoints so a fresh Claude session starts oriented. A SessionStart hook injects the compact map (with a staleness hint when it lags HEAD); /brain reads it and /brain index builds/refreshes it. Builds the map only — it never annotates code, and nothing outside brain/ is ever modified.
candor — [generic, quality, hooks] — Candour as a mechanism, not a pep talk. One blocking Stop gate, five clauses a script can prove: a file:line citation resolving to no file or past its end; a position retracted after bare pushback with no tool call in between; a completion claim after edits with nothing executed since; a task-runner run stopping without its recorded gate pass; a dependency map changed with an untouched lockfile. Flattery, apologies and defensive phrasing are counted by /candor:check and blocked by nothing, on purpose. Plus the terse reply mode (/candor:level lite|full|ultra|off): chat-message brevity as a shape contract — prose-line budgets and a fixed report skeleton, never less work in the turn.
code-architecture — [process, quality] — Engineering process: plan-before-code, YAGNI, SOLID principles applied with judgment, task orchestration, work verification — held at Stop by candor's gate (clause 3, refusing a completion claim when files were edited but nothing ran afterward) when candor is installed; without it the rule is prose — low-cognitive-load code, KISS/DRY simplicity principles. Owns structure at both levels: code (units, interfaces, file placement) and system (service boundaries on data ownership, scaling paths, cache placement, sync vs async integration, domain modeling) via the system-design and domain-modeling skills and the system-architect worker.
code-review — [review, quality] — Stack-agnostic code review: correctness bugs, code smells, convention drift on any diff or PR — severity-sorted one-line findings — plus comment discipline (default: no comment; write-time hooks warn, and deny the strictest patterns and any file over a 0.4:1 comment ceiling, at most twice per file per session; /code-review:comment-review). Defers structure/YAGNI to code-architecture, security depth to security, stack idioms to the per-framework review plugins. Includes /code-review:review, a code-reviewer agent, the code-smells, reuse-hygiene and comment-discipline skills; the fan-in loads every installed matching stack skill in one pass.
command-guard — [security, hooks, governance] — Destructive-command prevention: a PreToolUse hook that classifies every Bash (and MCP shell/SQL) command before it runs — denying irreversible data loss (migrate:fresh, DROP DATABASE, rm -rf /, docker compose down -v, terraform destroy, cloud deletes, overwriting a live .env, a cd into a missing dir) and prompting on scoped-but-destructive ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf on a path git cannot restore, kubectl delete pod). Reads through quotes, wrappers and heredocs; skips read-only commands; fail-open. A second PreToolUse config-guard asks before a write weakens settings, hooks, manifests or lint/test config. Ships /command-guard:check and a user-owned allow-file the agent cannot edit.
core-suite — [suite, generic, hooks] — Meta-bundle: the user-scope baseline — the plugins worth enabling once, globally, and keeping on in every repo: secret-scanning's write-time block, candor's five-clause Stop gate and dormant terse mode, code-review's fan-in review with comment discipline, git-workflow's branch finish, hindsight's friction mining, skill-router's file-aware routing, and stack-scan's report, audit and project-tier scout. Replaces always-on-suite and quality-suite (2026-09-14). Membership rule: project-agnostic, safe as a permanent fixture, adds no interruption you did not ask for — why command-guard's ask tier is not here. Uninstall with /core-suite:uninstall. 200k windows: read the README first.
craft-layer — [ui-ux, frontend, review] — Create unique, animated, informative web apps (CRM, SaaS, landing pages) across React, Tailwind, Vue, Next, Nuxt, and Laravel. /craft-layer:craft runs the studio pipeline end to end — creative direction, design research, asset sourcing with a licence gate, theming and component build via ui-ux, and a tiered motion system (Framer, anime.js, Three.js/R3F, Lottie/Rive, sprites) with reduced-motion and reduced-bundle fallbacks. /craft-layer:sections guides per-section decisions, /craft-layer:audit reviews a shipped tree, ultra-craft adds web research and a red-team. Ships the Three.js/R3F skill; its review arrives through /code-review:review. Requires ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit.
craft-suite — [suite, frontend, ui-ux] — Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer), plus ui-ux: per-library stack skills (shadcn, ReUI, Aceternity, Astryx, MUI, Tailwind), the WCAG audit, CSS-variable theming with a live colour preview, and the accessibility engineer that applies an audit's fix list. Live component-registry lookups route to the registries' own MCP servers — shadcn's and ReUI's — named in ui-ux's stack skills; this marketplace ships none. Uninstall with /craft-suite:uninstall.
database — [database, review, worker] — Relational databases in one plugin: the engine-agnostic sql-best-practices skill (sargable predicates, joins, indexes, NULL logic, transactions, keyset pagination, safe migrations, parameterization), the mariadb-best-practices dialect skill (10.6+ divergences, RETURNING, sequences, system-versioned tables, Galera) that the code-review fan-in loads only when the detected engine is MariaDB, a database-engineer worker that applies schema, migration, indexing and pooling work, and a PreToolUse guard that asks before a destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/unqualified DELETE-UPDATE, migration-DSL drops, CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY, NoSQL deleteMany/dropDatabase) lands.
debugging — [process, quality] — Systematic debugging: root cause before any fix — reproduce first, read the actual error, isolate with hypothesis tests and bisection, one change at a time, verify against the original symptom; escalation rule after three failed fixes. Ships a delegatable debugger agent for handing off the long reproduce-bisect investigation. Includes /debugging:debug.
design-kit — [ui-ux, frontend, tooling] — The Claude Desktop design picker as local, own-your-files commands: /design-kit:slides (self-contained HTML deck with notes; PDF and PPTX by script), /design-kit:design (artboard canvas of 2-4 directions with editable text and knobs; PNG/PDF), /design-kit:in-codebase (the design rendered with the project's OWN components on its dev server, plus handoff-bundle intake with a token-drift table), /design-kit:system (tokens, typefaces and a component inventory extracted from the repo or a URL into design-system/), /design-kit:artifact (one self-contained HTML page in a local gallery; LAN, pages-branch or zip sharing on consent). One localhost URL under .design-kit/; nothing leaves the machine unless you say yes.
devops — [devops, pipeline, review, worker] — Infrastructure in one plugin: CI/CD ordering, container/image hygiene, Kubernetes limits and probes, deploy strategy with rollback, and secrets handling (devops-practices); Dockerfile and compose discipline (docker-best-practices); and local dev environments generated from evidence — manifests, lockfiles, .env DSNs, CI images — via /devops:init (compose-init). One /devops:review loads the Docker skill when a Dockerfile or compose file is in scope, backed by a PreToolUse guard on workflow files and a devops-engineer worker + devops-reviewer pair. Owns infra-layer observability wiring; defers in-code instrumentation to resilience's observability skill.
frontend-suite — [suite, frontend] — Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, web-dev (Next.js, React Native, Vite skills, the generalist worker and the opus-floored frontend-reviewer), the WCAG audit inside ui-ux, skill auto-routing (skill-router), and code-review (the review fan-in that loads those skills for whatever the diff touches, plus comment discipline). Inertia lives in the laravel plugin (install by name). The creative-build studio, craft-layer, lives in craft-suite so ordinary frontend work does not pay its always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall.
git-workflow — [git, process] — Git workflow discipline: isolated worktrees for feature work, a structured finish protocol for development branches (verify, present options, merge/PR/park, clean up), and review-exchange rigor — what to include when requesting review, and technical verification before implementing received feedback. Ships a PreToolUse guard that refuses any commit, merge, tag or PR carrying a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer or a Generated-with-Claude-Code line. Includes /git-workflow:finish.
hindsight — [process, tooling] — Cross-session self-improvement loop: mines session and subagent transcripts for recurring friction and proposes CLAUDE.md rules, skill/plugin ideas, and defects against the plugin artifact that was running — applied only on approval.
laravel — [backend, review, worker] — Laravel best practices: Eloquent N+1 prevention, form requests, service layer, queues, policies, a per-version leverage map (Laravel 11/12/13), mass-assignment security — and the Inertia.js skill (v1/v2/v3, Vue/React/Svelte adapters: partial reloads, deferred props, useForm, shared data, SSR) it pairs with, loaded by the code-review fan-in when the manifests show it — plus the backend-engineer worker (PHP/Laravel) for implementation work; review fix lists go through task-runner's executor or inline, not this worker.
overseer — [pipeline, product, planning] — A program-level product owner for long, multi-session, multi-branch builds. /overseer:start "Build a CRM that manages clients" inventories the project and every installed plugin, asks one clarifying round, writes a milestone roadmap, then delivers each milestone on its own branch by briefing the taskmaster pipeline and task-runner execution with skill-pinned dispatch prompts. An accept script refuses to close a UI milestone until the app was driven in a real browser at three widths with a clean console; headless kinds (audit, library) close on a suite tail plus a captured run log. State under .claude/overseer/ lets /overseer:resume continue in a fresh session.
resilience — [backend, review, performance, observability] — Runtime quality in one plugin — does it stay up, can you see it, is it fast. Failure-mode design for integration points (timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaking, graceful degradation) with the error-handling and concurrency disciplines and the event-driven skill (brokers, outbox, sagas, DLQ); application observability (structured logs with correlation IDs, RED/USE metrics, trace propagation, honest health checks); measure-first performance (N+1, payload, bundle, Core Web Vitals, cache correctness). One audit, /resilience:review, over all six rubrics or one via --concern, and two workers, observability-engineer and performance-engineer, that apply only what a finding proves.
secret-scanning — [security, hooks] — Secret-leak prevention: a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Write/Edit, or a Bash heredoc/echo written to a file, introducing a high-confidence secret (cloud keys, private-key blocks, provider tokens, assigned secret literals) before it reaches disk, plus a /secret-scanning:scan command to sweep a path or diff on demand. Fail-open, high-confidence-only, with a fixture escape and CC_SECRET_SCAN=off. A PostToolUse unicode-scan warns on invisible and bidi characters (zero-width, U+202A-E, tag block) in text just written or read.
security — [security, review, worker] — Security for web apps: OWASP-aligned code review (injection, XSS, CSRF, authz vs authn, mass assignment, uploads, secrets, dependency audit) mapped to PHP/Laravel and JS/Vue, PLUS design-phase threat-modeling (STRIDE, trust boundaries), a data-privacy (GDPR/CCPA) regulatory lens, and an api-auth lens (token model, OAuth2+PKCE, scopes). Includes /security:review and a security-engineer worker agent.
skill-router — [tooling, hooks] — File-aware skill auto-routing: a PostToolUse hook injects one additionalContext directive to load the relevant best-practice skill(s) when you edit a matching file (PHP/Laravel/Blade, React/Vue/Inertia via .tsx/.jsx/.vue, plain .ts/.js/.py/.go/.rb/.rs, SQL and migrations (one engine-agnostic rubric, plus a MariaDB row where that engine is detected), components, tests, Dockerfiles, OpenAPI), a SessionStart hook primes a repo-tailored skill index, and low-confidence content signals flush as one digest on your next prompt (SessionEnd keeps the ledger). Every relevant skill co-fires per edit; fail-open, once per skill per session.
stack-scan — [tooling, research] — Know what is installed, keep it healthy, find what to add. /stack-scan:report inventories manifests, lockfiles (composer, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun), runtimes and docker images into a required-vs-installed table with drift, missing locks and EOL majors flagged. /stack-scan:audit runs the composer/npm vulnerability, outdated and licence checks — report-only. /stack-scan:suggest suggests every marketplace plugin in three tiers with cited evidence (--yes auto-installs tiers 1-2, --full the stack-relevant set after one confirm, --persist/--global set scope); --skills searches skills.sh for third-party skills — explicit picks only. Add-at-all is approaches' build-vs-buy.
task-runner — [worker, process, generic] — Disciplined task execution: one task at a time, scope locked to the task, bounded verify-fix inner loop per task, no drift, no unbounded outer loop. Completion means every check passed with evidence — held at Stop by candor's gate (clause 4) when candor is installed; without it a run can end by narration. Ships the shared task-executor agent — the delegatable 'apply the fixes' sink every review routes to — a PostToolUse scope-lock tripwire, parallel-planning (/task-runner:plan), and the subagent discipline (the orchestration plugin was merged in on 2026-09-14): delegation contracts, verification panels, scripts/dispatch-lint.sh, and the ultra-assess boost hook.
taskmaster — [planning, process] — Idea-to-execution clarification: brainstorm fuzzy ideas into approved designs, grill requirements until zero ambiguity, deliberate the implementation approach with a blind four-persona round (via the approaches plugin when installed; inline 2-3 approaches otherwise), decide visual choices with mockups, validate whole experiences with an interactive clickable demo, then emit milestone-grouped single-prompt task cards. Outputs live under taskmaster-docs/ (no collision with a project's own docs/).
testing — [testing, review, worker] — Testing best practices: test pyramid and what to actually test, Pest/PHPUnit and Vitest/Jest idioms, Playwright/Dusk e2e discipline, factories and fixtures, mocking boundaries, flaky-test causes, coverage traps — plus the TDD workflow (red-green-refactor, red-green regression proof for bug fixes). Includes /testing:flake-hunt and a test-engineer worker agent; the test rubric reaches any diff through /code-review:review.
toolchain-experts — [review, tooling, quality, frontend, backend] — Five expert reviewers that RUN the project's own static analysis instead of reciting a best-practice checklist: php-expert (phpstan, psalm, phpcs, rector), ts-expert (tsc, eslint, biome, oxlint), react-expert (the hook rules), vue-expert (vue-tsc, eslint-plugin-vue) and ui-expert (stylelint, pa11y, lighthouse-ci, axe). A detect-analyzers.sh mechanism reports which tool is configured, which one CI actually enforces, what the baseline already forgives and which rules are switched off — so the headline finding is the analyzer's blind spot, which no remembered rubric can produce. Read-only; fixes route to the existing workers.
ui-ux — [ui-ux, frontend, review, worker] — UI/UX best practices with per-stack skills: shadcn/ui, ReUI, Aceternity UI, Astryx, Material UI, Tailwind, plus a library-agnostic component-libraries skill (headless and styled React libraries, owned-code vs dependency rules, a per-library map) — plus a design-tokens skill (spacing/type/radius/elevation/motion scales + semantic color tiering), a theming-system skill, theme creation with a live colour preview, a /ui-ux:build entry point, a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit (/ui-ux:audit, the a11y-audit skill, and an a11y-engineer worker that applies the fix list with native semantics over ARIA patches), and ui-ux-reviewer + ui-ux-engineer agents.
ultra-deep-research — [research] — Deep-research harness that fans out parallel web searches, tiers sources by provenance, extracts date-stamped claims, and adversarially refutes them before synthesizing a cited report with a contradiction ledger and per-section confidence. Trigger 'ultra-deep-research' escalates to a Workflow-driven loop-until-dry fan-out with multi-vote refutation panels; standard depth runs a portable parallel-Agent fan-out. Ships /ultra-deep-research:research plus researcher and verifier subagents. Hand it a contract, RFP, standard, filing or long PDF and it swaps corroboration for coverage of that local corpus. Writes the report inline and to research/<topic>-<date>.md.
web-dev — [frontend, backend, worker, review] — Web development in one plugin: a web-developer worker (routing, REST/API integration, forms, state, SSR/CSR), an opus-floored frontend-reviewer for component and view logic, and three version-pinned stack skills — Next.js (App Router boundaries, opt-in caching, server actions, 14→16), React Native (lists, navigation, native-driver animation, Expo inversions), Vite (VITE_ env security, chunking, base, proxy, 5→8) — loaded by the code-review fan-in from the lockfile. Inertia and Laravel stay in their own plugins; plain JS/TS needs no skill.
workflow-suite — [suite, pipeline, process] — Meta-bundle: the whole idea-to-shipped pipeline in one install — the core-suite baseline (candor, code-review, git-workflow, hindsight, secret-scanning, skill-router, stack-scan) plus taskmaster clarification and cards, task-runner execution with delegation contracts, approaches deliberation, code-architecture plan-before-code and verification, testing, debugging, and the ui-ux and security lanes the cards dispatch into. Replaces taskmaster-suite, process-suite and quality-principles-suite (2026-09-14). Fifteen members: over the host's 200k skill-listing floor by design — the README names the settings line. Uninstall cleanly with /workflow-suite:uninstall.
